_: English dream symbols, same keys as symbols.json. Written by us in the general tradition of dream dictionaries; no named authors are quoted or credited. stems = word starts to look for in English text; a stem ending with a space matches a whole word only. name = display name.

вода.name: water
вода.long: Water shows what your feelings are doing. Clear and calm means things are settled inside; murky or rough means something has built up that you haven't said.
вода.folk: clear water for health and good news, muddy water for empty worries

море.name: sea
море.long: The sea is feeling on a scale bigger than you. A calm sea means you're ready for something large; a stormy one means a change is already moving and can't be held back by hand.
море.folk: a calm sea for a good journey, a stormy one for upheaval

река.name: river
река.long: A river is time and the way your life is moving. Swimming with the current means you trust what's happening; fighting it means you're pushing against something that won't give.
река.folk: crossing a river for a change of fortune

озеро.name: lake
озеро.long: A lake is still water with edges. It points to a quiet inner life, or to feelings you keep contained and calm on the surface.
озеро.folk: a clear lake for a peaceful life

дождь.name: rain
дождь.long: Rain washes things out. It often comes in dreams when tension is finally being released, sometimes as the tears you held back during the day.
дождь.folk: warm rain for money, cold rain for tears

снег.name: snow
снег.long: Snow covers everything and slows it down. Something in your life is on hold right now, waiting for its season.
снег.folk: clean snow for a fresh start, melting snow for news

огонь.name: fire
огонь.long: Fire is energy that warms or destroys. A steady flame means passion that serves you; a fire out of control means anger or desire that is running the show.
огонь.folk: a bright fire for joy, smoke and fire for a quarrel

ветер.name: wind
ветер.long: Wind is change you can feel but not see. A light breeze brings something new; a strong wind means circumstances are pushing you along.
ветер.folk: a strong wind for news from afar

гроза.name: thunderstorm
гроза.long: A thunderstorm is tension that finally breaks. After it, the air clears: something that has been building is about to come out into the open.

гора.name: mountain
гора.long: A mountain is a goal that takes effort. Climbing it means you're working toward something that matters; standing at the top means you're closer than you think.
гора.folk: climbing a mountain for success, falling from it for a setback

лес.name: forest
лес.long: A forest is the unknown, a place without clear paths. It often appears when you're facing a situation you can't yet see the way through.
лес.folk: a green forest for good luck, a dark one for confusion

поле.name: field
поле.long: An open field is room to move. It speaks of freedom, and of work that will bear fruit if you put the effort in.

небо.name: sky
небо.long: The sky is how far you let yourself look. A clear sky means the way ahead feels open; a heavy, low sky means something is pressing down on your plans.
небо.folk: a clear sky for good days ahead

солнце.name: sun
солнце.long: The sun lights everything up. It usually means clarity, warmth, and the feeling of being seen and appreciated.
солнце.folk: a bright sun for joy and success

луна.name: moon
луна.long: The moon rules the night side of things: intuition, secrets, what you don't say out loud. It asks you to notice what you sense but haven't named.
луна.folk: a full moon for fulfilment, a thin moon for waiting

звёзды.name: stars
звёзды.long: Stars are points to steer by in the dark. They speak of hope and of a goal you keep in sight even when everything around is unclear.
звёзды.folk: bright stars for a wish come true

собака.name: dog
собака.long: A dog stands for loyalty and friendship. A friendly dog is someone who has your back; an aggressive one points to a conflict with someone close.
собака.folk: a friendly dog for a true friend, a biting one for a quarrel

кошка.name: cat
кошка.long: A cat goes its own way. It can mean independence, intuition, or someone around you whose intentions are hard to read.
кошка.folk: a cat for small intrigues, a black cat for gossip

змея.name: snake
змея.long: A snake has two sides. It can warn you about someone who says one thing and does another, or it can mean shedding a skin: the old is falling away because you've outgrown it.
змея.folk: a hidden ill-wisher, or a renewal

птица.name: bird
птица.long: Birds carry messages. A bird in flight often means news on its way or a thought that wants to be free.
птица.folk: a bird at the window for news

рыба.name: fish
рыба.long: Fish live in deep water. They can mean an unexpected gain, or something rising from your inner depths that you're only starting to notice.
рыба.folk: catching fish for profit, a live fish for good news

лошадь.name: horse
лошадь.long: A horse is energy and drive. Riding it means you're in control of your strength; a runaway horse means your drive is carrying you where you didn't plan to go.
лошадь.folk: a white horse for good fortune

волк.name: wolf
волк.long: A wolf is a predator with its own agenda. It may point to someone around you acting in their own interest, or to your own wilder instincts.
волк.folk: a wolf for a cunning enemy

медведь.name: bear
медведь.long: A bear is raw, heavy power. It may be a strong person in your life, or your own strength that you're afraid to let out.
медведь.folk: a bear for a powerful rival

паук.name: spider
паук.long: A spider weaves a web. It speaks of connections and plans, and sometimes of feeling caught in someone else's.
паук.folk: a spider for a letter or news

мышь.name: mouse
мышь.long: Mice and rats nibble away quietly. They point to small worries or minor losses that add up if you ignore them.

корова.name: cow
корова.long: A cow is abundance and nourishment. It speaks of a comfortable, well-provided life, or of a need to be looked after.
корова.folk: a well-fed cow for a prosperous year

насекомые.name: insects
насекомые.long: Insects are small things that swarm. They often point to petty irritations that are taking up more of your attention than they deserve.
насекомые.folk: insects for small troubles and gossip

мать.name: mother
мать.long: A mother in a dream is care and protection. She often appears when you need support, or when you're the one giving it to others.
мать.folk: seeing your mother for good news

отец.name: father
отец.long: A father stands for authority, rules and protection. His appearance often speaks of how you deal with duty and with making decisions alone.
отец.folk: seeing your father for advice worth taking

ребёнок.name: child
ребёнок.long: A child is something new and still fragile: an idea, a project, a new side of yourself. It needs attention to grow.
ребёнок.folk: a happy child for joy, a crying one for worries

покойник.name: the deceased
покойник.long: The dead in dreams rarely mean death. More often they mark the end of a period, or bring back a person whose presence and words still matter to you.
покойник.folk: a deceased relative for a change in the weather or for news

незнакомец.name: stranger
stems: a man i didn t know
a woman i didn t know
незнакомец.long: A stranger is often a side of yourself you haven't met yet. Notice how they behaved: that's the quality trying to get your attention.
незнакомец.folk: a stranger for a new acquaintance

друг.name: friend
друг.long: A friend in a dream is support and trust. Sometimes they reflect a quality of theirs you'd like more of in yourself.
друг.folk: meeting a friend for good news

враг.name: enemy
враг.long: An enemy or a fight is tension brought into the open. It may be a real conflict, or an argument you're having with yourself.

толпа.name: crowd
толпа.long: A crowd is the pressure of others. It can mean you feel lost among expectations, or that you care a lot about what people think.
толпа.folk: a crowd for rumours and bustle

свадьба.name: wedding
свадьба.long: A wedding is a joining together. It can be about a relationship, but just as often about a new commitment, a partnership, or bringing two parts of your life together.
свадьба.folk: a wedding for change in life

беременность.name: pregnancy
беременность.long: Pregnancy in a dream is rarely literal. It usually means something is growing inside you, an idea or a plan that needs time before it comes out.
беременность.folk: pregnancy for profit or new plans

полёт.name: flying
полёт.long: Flying is one of the best dreams to have. It speaks of freedom, of rising above a problem, and of the feeling that you can do more than you thought.
полёт.folk: flying high for success and a rise

падение.name: falling
падение.long: Falling is the feeling of losing control. It often comes when something in life feels unstable and you're not sure what's holding you up.
падение.folk: falling for a setback, landing softly for a quick recovery

бег.name: running
бег.long: Running is haste and effort. Ask yourself whether you were running toward something or away from it: that's the key to the dream.
бег.folk: running for a lot of fuss

погоня.name: chase
погоня.long: Being chased is the most common anxious dream. What chases you is usually something you're avoiding: a conversation, a decision, a feeling.
погоня.folk: escaping a chase for getting out of trouble

поиск.name: searching
поиск.long: Searching or losing something points to a gap: something or someone you feel is missing right now, or a part of yourself you've put aside.
поиск.folk: finding what was lost for good news

опоздание.name: being late
опоздание.long: Being late in a dream reflects pressure: too many things at once and the fear of missing a chance. It says more about your load than about any real deadline.
опоздание.folk: being late for a missed chance

экзамен.name: exam
экзамен.long: An exam dream is about being evaluated. It often comes years after school, whenever you feel someone is checking whether you measure up.
экзамен.folk: passing an exam for success in your affairs

плавание.name: swimming
плавание.long: Swimming is how you move through your emotions. Easy swimming means you're handling them; struggling means the water is heavier than you admit.
плавание.folk: swimming in clear water for good luck

утопание.name: drowning
утопание.long: Drowning is the feeling of being overwhelmed. There's more on you right now than you can hold, and the dream asks you to let something go.
утопание.folk: being saved from water for help arriving in time

прощание.name: farewell
прощание.long: A farewell is a chapter closing. It may be about a person, but more often about a habit, a role or a period you're leaving behind.
прощание.folk: a farewell for a meeting soon after

зубы.name: teeth
зубы.long: Teeth are about how steady you feel and how well you take a hit. Losing them is traditionally read as a loss, but more often it's about tiredness and things you didn't get to say.
зубы.folk: losing teeth for a loss: without blood someone else's, with blood your own

волосы.name: hair
волосы.long: Hair is strength and how you present yourself. Cutting it means wanting change; losing it points to worry about your strength or looks.
волосы.folk: long hair for a long road, cutting hair for a change

кровь.name: blood
кровь.long: Blood is life force and family ties. Seeing it often means you're spending a lot of energy, or that a family matter is on your mind.
кровь.folk: blood for a visit from relatives

руки.name: hands
руки.long: Hands are what you do. Strong, clean hands mean you feel capable; hurt or tied hands mean something is stopping you from acting.
руки.folk: clean hands for good work, dirty hands for gossip

глаза.name: eyes
глаза.long: Eyes are about seeing clearly. Poor sight in a dream suggests there's something you don't want to look at; a clear gaze means you already see the answer.
глаза.folk: clear eyes for clarity in your affairs

нагота.name: nakedness
нагота.long: Being naked is feeling exposed. It often comes when you're afraid people will see something you'd rather keep private, or when you're simply tired of pretending.
нагота.folk: nakedness for an embarrassing situation that passes quickly

болезнь.name: illness
болезнь.long: Illness in a dream is rarely about the body. More often it's a sign of exhaustion, or of a situation that's draining you slowly.
болезнь.folk: being ill in a dream for good health

рана.name: wound
рана.long: A wound is an old hurt that still stings. The dream points to where you're still sensitive, and to what needs care rather than being ignored.
рана.folk: a wound without blood for a small worry

дом.name: house
дом.long: A house in a dream is you. Its rooms are parts of your life: note which were bright, which were locked, and what state the house was in.
дом.folk: a new house for change, an old one for memories

дверь.name: door
дверь.long: A door is a chance or a choice. An open door invites you in; a locked one means something isn't ready yet, or you're not ready for it.
дверь.folk: an open door for guests, a locked one for delays

окно.name: window
окно.long: A window is your view of the world and of your prospects. What you saw through it shows what you're hoping for or worried about.
окно.folk: looking out of a window for news

лестница.name: stairs
лестница.long: Stairs are progress step by step. Going up means growth and effort; going down means returning to something deeper or older.
лестница.folk: going up stairs for success, going down for a setback

дорога.name: road
дорога.long: A road is the direction your life is taking. A smooth road means things are going to plan; a broken one or a fork means a choice is coming.
дорога.folk: a straight road for an easy journey

мост.name: bridge
мост.long: A bridge links two sides: the old and the new. Crossing it means you're in the middle of a change; a shaky bridge means the change feels unsafe.
мост.folk: crossing a bridge for overcoming a difficulty

подвал.name: basement
подвал.long: A basement is what you keep out of sight: old fears, memories, things you'd rather not deal with. Going down there means you're ready to look.
подвал.folk: a basement for a secret coming to light

чердак.name: attic
чердак.long: An attic stores the past and unfinished plans. Finding something there often means an old idea or memory is worth taking out again.
чердак.folk: an attic for memories of the past

храм.name: church
храм.long: A church or temple is a search for meaning and calm. It often appears when you're looking for answers bigger than everyday concerns.
храм.folk: a church for peace of mind

школа.name: school
школа.long: School in a dream is a lesson life is teaching you now. Think about what you're being tested on in real life at the moment.

кладбище.name: cemetery
кладбище.long: A cemetery is the past put to rest. It often appears when you're ready to let something go, or when memories come back.
кладбище.folk: a cemetery for a long life

вокзал.name: station
вокзал.long: A station or airport is a point of departure. You're between one stage and the next, and the dream asks where you actually want to go.
вокзал.folk: a station for a journey or a change

поезд.name: train
поезд.long: A train runs on rails. It speaks of a course already set: a routine or a plan you're following. Missing it means fear of missing your chance.

машина.name: car
машина.long: A car is how you steer your life. Who is driving matters most: if it's not you, someone else is setting your direction.

деньги.name: money
деньги.long: Money in a dream is about what you value, including yourself. Finding it means feeling your worth; losing it means worry about your resources.
деньги.folk: coins for tears, paper money for gain

кольцо.name: ring
кольцо.long: A ring is a promise and a bond. Its condition shows how you feel about a commitment: whole and bright, or lost and broken.
кольцо.folk: a ring for an engagement, a lost ring for a quarrel

нож.name: knife
нож.long: A knife cuts. It points to a break, a sharp word, or the need to cut something out of your life.

зеркало.name: mirror
зеркало.long: A mirror shows how you see yourself. What you saw in it, familiar or strange, says how you feel about who you are right now.
зеркало.folk: a broken mirror for a disappointment

ключ.name: key
ключ.long: A key is the answer to a problem. Finding it means the solution is closer than you think; losing it means you feel shut out of something.
ключ.folk: finding a key for a problem solved

письмо.name: letter
письмо.long: A letter is news or something that needs saying. Who wrote it and whether you read it tells you which conversation is waiting.

телефон.name: phone
телефон.long: A phone is about contact. A call that won't go through means feeling unheard; a call that comes in means someone wants to reach you.

книга.name: book
книга.long: A book is knowledge and your own story. Reading it means you're learning something; an unreadable page means an answer isn't clear yet.

часы.name: clock
часы.long: A clock is time pressure. A stopped clock suggests a pause or feeling stuck; one running fast means you feel you're falling behind.
часы.folk: a stopped clock for a pause in your affairs

одежда.name: clothes
одежда.long: Clothes are the role you play in front of others. Wrong or dirty clothes mean discomfort with that role; new clothes mean you're trying on a new one.
одежда.folk: new clothes for a change, torn clothes for worries

обувь.name: shoes
обувь.long: Shoes are readiness to move forward. Losing them or walking barefoot means you feel unprepared for the road ahead.

еда.name: food
еда.long: Food is what feeds you, and not only the body. Eating with pleasure means you're getting what you need; hunger means something in life is missing.

хлеб.name: bread
хлеб.long: Bread is the basics: security and daily needs. Fresh bread means stability; stale bread means worry about getting by.

вино.name: wine
вино.long: Wine and drink are about relaxing control. A little means enjoyment; too much suggests you want to escape something for a while.

темнота.name: darkness
темнота.long: Darkness is what you can't see yet. It often comes with uncertainty about the future, and the fear is less about the dark than about not knowing.
темнота.folk: darkness for doubts that clear up soon

свет.name: light
свет.long: Light is understanding. A light in the dark means you're finding a way out or a clue that makes sense of things.
свет.folk: a bright light for good news

страх.name: fear
страх.long: Fear in a dream is tension your mind is working off. It doesn't predict trouble; it shows what you've been carrying during the day.
страх.folk: being afraid in a dream for calm in real life

плач.name: crying
плач.long: Crying in a dream is release. Feelings you've held back find a way out, and you often wake up lighter.
плач.folk: crying in a dream for joy in real life

смех.name: laughter
смех.long: Laughter is relief and ease. It comes when tension is leaving and you're ready to take things less seriously.

полиция.name: police
полиция.long: Police and courts are control and judgment. They often appear when you feel guilty, watched, or bound by someone else's rules.
полиция.folk: the police for a dispute that ends well

война.name: war
война.long: War in a dream is great inner strain. It often reflects a conflict you're living through, with people or with yourself.

работа.name: work
работа.long: Work in a dream carries the day's concerns into the night. It speaks of responsibility, recognition, and how much of yourself you give to your job.
работа.folk: work in a dream for a busy stretch

измена.name: infidelity
измена.long: Infidelity dreams are almost never about actual cheating. They reflect fear of losing closeness or attention, or the feeling that something takes your partner away from you.
измена.folk: infidelity in a dream for loyalty in real life

жена.name: wife
жена.long: A wife in a dream speaks of closeness, trust and home. How things were between you in the dream shows what's on your mind about the relationship.
жена.folk: a smiling wife for peace at home

муж.name: husband
муж.long: A husband in a dream stands for support and safety. The dream reflects how secure you feel in the relationship right now.
муж.folk: a husband in a dream for news at home

высота.name: height
высота.long: Being high up is about your position and your view of things. It feels good when you're confident, frightening when you fear losing what you've reached.

стройка.name: construction
стройка.long: A construction site is something you're building in life: a career, a family, a plan. Its state shows how solid you feel that project is.
стройка.folk: a construction site for new undertakings

опора.name: support
опора.long: Railings, balance and shaky ground are about what holds you up. The dream asks what you rely on, and whether it's as steady as you'd like.
опора.folk: a firm support for reliable friends

нога.name: legs
нога.long: Legs are what carry you forward. Strong legs mean confidence in your path; hurt or weak legs mean you feel held back.
нога.folk: a hurt leg for a delay on the road

голова.name: head
голова.long: The head is thinking and decisions. A headache or injury in a dream suggests you're overthinking or carrying too many decisions at once.
голова.folk: a clear head for a sound decision

лицо.name: face
лицо.long: A face is how you appear to others. A strange or hidden face suggests you're unsure how you come across, or feel you're wearing a mask.

живот.name: belly
живот.long: The belly is gut feeling and inner reserves. Pain there often points to worry you're carrying but not expressing.

сердце.name: heart
сердце.long: The heart is your deepest feelings. A racing heart in a dream means strong emotion; heart pain means something close to you hurts.

укус.name: bite
укус.long: A bite is a sharp, sudden hurt. It often mirrors a remark or an act that stung you more than you let on.
укус.folk: a bite for a hurtful word from someone close

бывший.name: ex
бывший.long: An ex in a dream is rarely about getting back together. More often it's about something from that time that isn't finished: a feeling, a lesson, or a part of yourself.
бывший.folk: an ex for news from the past

сестра.name: sister
сестра.long: A sister stands for closeness, rivalry and support. Her mood in the dream shows what you need from the people closest to you.
сестра.folk: a sister for a family matter

брат.name: brother
брат.long: A brother is someone at your side, or a rival. His role in the dream shows how supported you feel.
брат.folk: a brother for help in a hard moment

бабушка.name: grandmother
бабушка.long: A grandmother is family wisdom and care. She often appears when you need advice or the feeling that someone is looking out for you.

дедушка.name: grandfather
дедушка.long: A grandfather is experience and tradition. His words in a dream are often something you already know but haven't listened to.

знаменитость.name: celebrity
знаменитость.long: Meeting a celebrity is about recognition. It often reflects the wish to be noticed, or a quality of that person you'd like to have.
знаменитость.folk: meeting someone famous for a rise

туалет.name: toilet
туалет.long: Toilet dreams are about letting go of what you don't need. Not finding one, or having no privacy, often means you have no space for yourself right now.
туалет.folk: a toilet for getting rid of worries

ванная.name: bath
ванная.long: Washing in a dream is cleansing. You want to wash off tiredness, guilt or someone else's influence and start fresh.
ванная.folk: washing in clean water for health

кухня.name: kitchen
кухня.long: A kitchen is the heart of the home: care, family and nourishment. What happened there shows what's going on with your home life.
кухня.folk: a warm kitchen for a peaceful home

лифт.name: elevator
лифт.long: An elevator moves you up or down fast. Going up means a rise; falling or getting stuck means worry about your position.
лифт.folk: going up in an elevator for promotion

самолёт.name: plane
самолёт.long: A plane is big plans and fast movement. A smooth flight means things are going well; a rough one means worry about a project that's already in the air.
самолёт.folk: a plane for a long journey

автобус.name: bus
автобус.long: A bus or tram is a road shared with others. It speaks of going along with a group and of not being the one who chooses the route.
автобус.folk: a bus for a joint venture

авария.name: accident
авария.long: An accident is a sudden stop. It often comes when life is moving too fast and something needs to slow down before it breaks.
авария.folk: an accident for a warning to be careful

наводнение.name: flood
наводнение.long: A flood is feeling that has burst its banks. There's more going on inside than you can contain, and it's looking for a way out.

лёд.name: ice
лёд.long: Ice is frozen feeling. Something is on hold, and walking on ice means a risky situation where you have to tread carefully.
лёд.folk: thin ice for a risky step

лужа.name: puddle
лужа.long: A puddle is a small obstacle. It points to minor annoyances that are easy to step over if you see them in time.
лужа.folk: stepping in a puddle for a small embarrassment

грязь.name: mud
грязь.long: Mud and dirt are what weighs on you: gossip, guilt, a situation that feels messy. Cleaning it off means you're ready to be rid of it.

лягушка.name: frog
лягушка.long: A frog is transformation. Something that looks unremarkable now may turn out to be the start of a change.
лягушка.folk: a frog for a pleasant surprise

червь.name: worms
червь.long: Worms are what eats away from the inside: a doubt, a small resentment, a worry you keep pushing aside.

тигр.name: tiger
тигр.long: A tiger is bright, dangerous power. It may be a strong personality near you, or your own force that wants to come out.
тигр.folk: a tiger for a strong rival

лев.name: lion
лев.long: A lion is power and dignity. It often appears when you're dealing with authority, or learning to claim your own.
лев.folk: a lion for a meeting with an influential person

крокодил.name: crocodile
крокодил.long: A crocodile waits quietly in the water. It warns of a danger that looks calm on the surface, or of someone who hides their intentions.
крокодил.folk: a crocodile for a hidden enemy

свинья.name: pig
свинья.long: A pig is abundance and everyday comfort. It can also point to indulgence, or to someone behaving without much grace.

курица.name: chicken
курица.long: Chickens are everyday cares and small tasks. They speak of home, busy days and looking after others.

яйцо.name: egg
яйцо.long: An egg is potential, something not yet born. A whole egg means a promising start; a broken one means a plan that needs protecting.

сумка.name: bag
сумка.long: A bag is what you carry through life: responsibilities, memories, worries. Losing it often means fear of losing something important or yourself.
сумка.folk: a heavy bag for extra work

документы.name: documents
документы.long: Documents are identity and status. Losing them means worry about your position; getting them in order means things are settling.

золото.name: gold
золото.long: Gold and jewels are what you truly value. Finding treasure means recognising your worth; chasing it can be a sign of temptation.
золото.folk: finding gold for a pleasant find

цветы.name: flowers
цветы.long: Flowers are joy, beauty and attention. Receiving them means feeling appreciated; wilted flowers mean something beautiful is fading.
цветы.folk: fresh flowers for joy, wilted ones for regret

торт.name: cake
торт.long: Cake and sweets are small pleasures and rewards. They remind you to let yourself enjoy things, not just get through them.

убийство.name: killing
убийство.short: an abrupt end of the old
убийство.long: Killing in a dream is not about violence. It's about ending something abruptly: a habit, a role or a relationship that has run its course.
убийство.folk: a killing in a dream for the end of a long worry

ремонт.name: renovation
ремонт.long: Renovation is changing your life from the inside. You're fixing what's worn out and making room for something new.

переезд.name: moving house
переезд.long: Moving house is a new chapter. It often comes when you're ready to leave one stage of life for another.
переезд.folk: moving for a change of fortune

блуждание.name: being lost
stems: couldn t find a way out
блуждание.long: Being lost means you're unsure of your direction. The dream isn't a verdict, it's a question: where do you actually want to go?
блуждание.folk: finding your way out for a problem solved

крик.name: scream
крик.long: A scream is what you haven't been able to say. If no sound came out, there's something important you're holding back.

поцелуй.name: kiss
поцелуй.long: A kiss or a hug is warmth and closeness. It speaks of a need for tenderness, or of reconciliation with someone.

близость.name: intimacy
близость.long: Intimacy in a dream is about closeness and merging, and not always with the person in the dream. Often it's about a quality of theirs you want to bring into your life.
близость.folk: intimacy in a dream for a new connection

смерть.name: death
смерть.long: Death in a dream almost never means real death. It marks the end of one stage and the start of another: something is being left behind.
смерть.folk: death in a dream for a long life

ангел.name: angel
ангел.long: An angel is protection and comfort. It often appears in hard times, as a sign that you're not as alone as you feel.
ангел.folk: an angel for help from above

молитва.name: prayer
молитва.long: Praying in a dream is asking for help or support. It shows where you feel you can't cope on your own.

нечисть.name: demon
нечисть.long: Demons and monsters are fear given a shape. They show what frightens you, and facing them in a dream often takes away their power.
нечисть.folk: driving away evil spirits for overcoming trouble

призрак.name: ghost
призрак.long: A ghost is the past that hasn't left. It may be a memory, guilt, or a relationship you haven't fully let go of.
призрак.folk: a ghost for news from the past

кровать.name: bed
кровать.long: A bed is rest and your private life. Its state in the dream shows how much you let yourself recover.

праздник.name: party
праздник.long: A party or celebration is about company and joy. It often reflects a wish to be among people, or a feeling that there's something worth celebrating.

магазин.name: shop
магазин.long: A shop is about choices and desires. What you were looking for and whether you could afford it shows what you want right now.

фрукты.name: fruit
фрукты.long: Fruit is the result of effort. Ripe fruit means your work is paying off; unripe or rotten fruit means you're rushing or have waited too long.

сад.name: garden
сад.long: A garden is what you're growing in life: relationships, projects, yourself. A flourishing garden means care is paying off.

пустыня.name: desert
пустыня.long: A desert is solitude and emptiness. It often comes when you feel alone, or when you're searching for something that isn't around you yet.
пустыня.folk: a desert for a lonely stretch

землетрясение.name: earthquake
землетрясение.long: An earthquake shakes the ground you stand on. Something you took for granted is changing, and the dream reflects that unsteadiness.

буря.name: storm
буря.long: A storm is turbulence: fast events, strong emotions, things out of your control. It passes, and the dream often comes right before the calm.
буря.folk: a storm for a turbulent period

радуга.name: rainbow
радуга.long: A rainbow comes after the storm. It's hope and the promise that a hard stretch is ending.

оружие.name: weapon
оружие.long: A weapon is about defence and force. Holding it means you feel you have to protect yourself; being threatened by it means you feel under pressure.

оцепенение.name: paralysis
оцепенение.long: Not being able to move or shout is one of the most common dreams. It reflects helplessness in some situation, and the body itself is still in sleep mode.
оцепенение.folk: being unable to move for a delay

лиса.name: fox
лиса.long: A fox is cleverness and cunning. It may warn of someone playing games, or suggest you use your wits rather than force.
лиса.folk: a fox for a sly person nearby

заяц.name: hare
заяц.long: A hare or rabbit is quick and wary. It points to nervousness, or to a chance you need to catch before it runs off.
заяц.folk: a hare for a fleeting chance

слон.name: elephant
слон.long: An elephant is strength, patience and memory. It often appears when you need stability, or when an old memory comes back.
слон.folk: an elephant for success and respect

бабочка.name: butterfly
бабочка.long: A butterfly is transformation and lightness. Something in you is changing, and the change is a good one.

паразиты.name: parasites
паразиты.long: Parasites are what drains your energy: people or habits that take more than they give.

подарок.name: gift
подарок.long: A gift is attention and recognition. Receiving it means you want to be valued; giving it means you want to share.
подарок.folk: a gift for a pleasant surprise

лодка.name: boat
лодка.long: A boat carries you across your feelings and life. Smooth sailing means confidence; a leaky or rocking boat means feeling unsafe.
лодка.folk: a boat on calm water for a good journey

город.name: city
город.long: A city is society and possibility. An unfamiliar city means new opportunities; getting lost in it means feeling overwhelmed.
город.folk: a big city for new acquaintances

комната.name: room
комната.long: A room is a part of your inner world. Finding a new room means discovering something about yourself you didn't know.
комната.folk: a bright room for good news

родня супруга.name: in-laws
родня супруга.long: In-laws in a dream speak of family relations and of the rules of a family that isn't quite yours. They often reflect tension about fitting in.

родственники.name: relatives
родственники.long: Relatives are your roots and family ties. They often appear when family matters or old patterns are on your mind.

сын.name: son
сын.long: A son in a dream is care, responsibility and continuity. It may reflect worry for him, or a young, hopeful side of yourself.

дочь.name: daughter
дочь.long: A daughter in a dream is tenderness and care. It may reflect concern for her, or a gentle side of yourself that needs attention.
дочь.folk: a daughter for a pleasant surprise

власть.name: authority
власть.long: Kings, presidents and rulers are about power and influence. They show how you relate to authority, or how much control you want over your own life.
власть.folk: meeting a ruler for a rise

сцена.name: stage
сцена.long: Being on stage is about being seen. It reflects a wish for recognition, or fear of being judged in front of others.

мусор.name: trash
мусор.long: Trash is what you no longer need. Taking it out means you're ready to let go; being buried in it means too much has piled up.
мусор.folk: taking out trash for getting rid of trouble

мясо.name: meat
мясо.long: Meat is strength and reserves. Cooked meat means you have what you need; raw meat means something still needs work.
мясо.folk: cooked meat for prosperity, raw meat for worries

грибы.name: mushrooms
грибы.long: Mushrooms appear suddenly, overnight. They point to unexpected luck, or to something that grew quietly while you weren't looking.
грибы.folk: picking mushrooms for an unexpected gain

пещера.name: cave
пещера.long: A cave is the depth of your inner world. Going in means looking into yourself; the way out means finding an answer.
пещера.folk: a cave for a secret revealed

болото.name: swamp
болото.long: A swamp is being stuck. It often comes when a situation drags on and every effort seems to pull you deeper.
болото.folk: a swamp for a long, tiresome matter

туман.name: fog
туман.long: Fog is uncertainty. Things are unclear right now, and the dream suggests waiting until the view clears before acting.
